scope: Only crates/deadpan-app/src/preview/harness/gain.rs changes runtime code. Production rendering, scrolling, commands, PCM and history are unchanged.
findings: The prior 8-frame delay samples moving geometry while discrete-wheel smoothing is active. The 96-point waveform fits the 109-point compact clip; its final failed allocation was ten points above that clip.
A bounded native-scroll-state wait fixes overshoot. Repeating large 2048-point discrete bursts then exhausts the existing 6000-frame trace cap; that failed attempt is retained.
Precision placement uses real Start/Move/End trackpad events. End follows on another frame so it cannot clear the Move delta before egui consumes it. No scroll state is set directly.
Both compact and default viewports retain explicit discrete-wheel checks: native smoothing finishes, full -24-point motion is measured, and revision is unchanged.
Existing complete-graph, axis, hit-target and focus assertions remain. The global trace cap stays 6000; the final visual replay uses 5273 frames.

Five inspected final captures show complete waveform/curve axes, fixed action controls and keyboard-visible Retry; the wide curve retains its exact fields beside it. Board v3 remains a visual target, not a claim of complete workspace parity.
limits: Offscreen Metal only; physical mouse/trackpad, OS IME, VoiceOver and acoustic quality are not established
Debug visual timings are not release-performance evidence
